description: Military and field camps (place type 4, camp or hold): the vanilla Imperial Legion camp set as Skyrim's civil-war camps place it, each piece licensed for an exterior camp by its own plugin (kit-setting-class.json). Tents are open-fronted canvas walked into from the front (no door, no interior cell: a camp's tents are open buildings, decision 0114 rule 3). largeimperialtent01 is the command tent that holds civilwartable01; smallimperialtent is the sleeping tent, pitched in a line 4.13 m apart (mined template vanilla:t0224); civilwarbannerimp01 hangs from its pole civilwarbanner01 (cloth drawn double-sided, as its NIF draws it) by the mined band pair (8 plugin placements) at the tent line. Left out on their licence (R1): civilwarcot01, civilwarmap01 and bedrollground (interior only), civilwarbannerimp02 (no camp), note01 (no plugin places it as a static). Kept out of works-v1 so the tents and banners download only where a camp loads them (standard 16). The fire, brazier, firewood, crates and sacks come from works-v1; the palisade stakes (stockadepike01) and the road block (stockadebarricade01) from enclosure-v1.
